claims.customer_statement: I was pulling out of a car park when another vehicle reversed into the back of my car without looking. The rear bumper and the rear quarter panel both have scrapes and some paint transfer from the other car. The other driver stayed and we exchanged details.

I was stationary at a traffic light when the car behind failed to stop in time and drove into the back of my car. The rear bumper is dented and scraped. The other driver admitted fault and gave me their insurance details.

Someone opened their car door into mine while I was parked in a multi-storey car park. I came back to find a dent on my driver's door. There was no note left and no one around to identify the other vehicle.

My car was parked on a residential street when a delivery van sideswiped the driver's door as it passed. A neighbour across the road saw it happen but the van did not stop. The door has a visible dent.
I misjudged the gap between my car and a concrete bollard at a car wash entrance and clipped the driver's door. There are scrapes and a small dent along the door. It was my fault.

I parked my car in a supermarket car park and came back to find the rear quarter panel dented and scraped. No note was left. I checked for CCTV but the car park attendant said the cameras in that bay were not working.

While my car was parked in a shopping centre car park, someone bumped the rear bumper and drove off without leaving a note. The bumper has a dent and a scrape. I noticed it when I returned to the car.

I found my car damaged when I returned to the car park at work. There are long scrapes on the rear bumper and orange paint transfer from another vehicle. No note was left. I believe another car hit me while reversing out of an adjacent space.

My car was broken into overnight while parked outside my home. The driver's side window was smashed and my bag was taken from the back seat. I called the police straight away and have a crime reference number.

I was waiting to pull out of a side road when a car came around the bend faster than expected and struck the rear of my car. The impact was significant. The trunk and rear bumper are badly dented and crumpled. The other driver's insurer has accepted liability.

I was travelling on the motorway when a lorry pulled out of a slip road and struck the rear of my car at speed. The rear bumper, rear quarter panel, and taillight are all damaged. The taillight is completely broken. I have a police report number.

I scraped the front left side of my car against a concrete barrier while parallel parking on a narrow street. The front quarter panel has scrapes, a dent, and some paint transfer. The wheel also has visible scratches. It was my fault.

A supermarket trolley rolled across the car park in the wind and hit my driver's door. It left a small dent. I did not think it was serious at the time but the body shop says it needs a full panel repair.
Someone lightly grazed the left side of my car while I was parked on the street. There is a small mark near the front. I only noticed it the next morning.
There was a hailstorm last week while my car was parked outside. When I came back I noticed the windshield was cracked in several places. The damage must have been caused by hailstones.

A small stone flicked up from a lorry on the motorway and hit my rear window. There was a small chip at first but over a couple of days it spread into a crack and I can no longer drive safely with it.

I was stopped at a red light when a car behind me failed to brake and hit me at speed. The rear bumper is crushed and the back panel is badly dented. The boot will not close properly. The other driver drove away before I could get their details.

Another car ran a red light at an intersection and hit me head-on. The front end of my car is severely damaged. The bumper, hood, and both front quarter panels need replacing. The airbags deployed. I have a police incident number.

I scraped the passenger side of my car against a brick wall while reversing out of a narrow lane. The paint is badly scratched along the rear door and rear quarter panel. I did not take a photo at the time and do not have one to provide.

A car failed to give way at a roundabout and struck the driver's side of my car at speed in late April. The damage is extensive across the door, front quarter panel, and roof. I was taken to hospital with minor injuries and have been recovering since. I am only now able to deal with paperwork. I have a police report and hospital discharge letter.
